title: NeuroTx-MOOD: Contextual Conformal Calibration for BBB and CNS Screening
description: Experimental code and machine-readable results for contextual conformal calibration, leakage-audited blood-brain barrier screening, assay-aware ChEMBL evaluation, fixed-score ablations, and deployment-guard analyses.
